notes.title: 1.1.0 Beta - Russian translation
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29187116/9157ff4e7ac82b107f78f1517440c9c71b0d72b6.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just released a Beyond Eden 1.1.0 beta version with Russian applied.
(Thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/thgofficialtl]THG Official Tl.[/url] for great working on the Russian translation!)

In this beta test, anyone who owns a Beyond Eden in the Steam library can participate.

You can play the beta version by following the steps below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29187116/d8e60df43a08a62a0b5592a4b12220ef61e3dd5a.png[/img]


After some testing period, we will release 1.10 officially.

You can report bug or typo or unnatural sentences [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/632800/discussions/0/1482109512313793356/]here[/url].


[i][b]Note :[/b][/i]
We recommend that you start playing again after erasing all existing save data.
Before starting the beta version, delete both save folders below.

A. Local data
~/steamapps/common/Beyond Eden/game/saves

B. Persistent data
Windows: %APPDATA%/Roaming/RenPy/beyond_eden/
Mac OS X: ~/Library/RenPy/beyond_eden/

notes.title: Our New Game, Beyond Eden: Dear Edward
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29187116/aa09f1e60ed53b87a229cbb6cd0db89a439a0bd3.png[/img]

Greetings!
We at Studio Pieplus are pleased to announce the development of the "Beyond Eden"'s spin-Off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202580/Beyond_Eden_Dear_Edward/

What happened after "Beyond Eden" when Alex decided to abandon his quest for revenge against the Edenics?

The gullible and callow aristocrat Edward winds up with 1000 pounds in gambling debt.  
But rather than own up to his stern elder brother, Edward chooses a 1-year loan from his crush Alex.
In return, Edward agrees to pay Alex back while working for his company in London.
Can Edward pay off his debts within a year, and also confess his feelings to Alex?
Will Edward be of any use at all to Alex, considering that he has never worked a day in his life?
Can Edward quit gambling after so many years of addiction?
Is it true that the London town house where he resides is haunted?
And why does Edward avoid reuniting with his former classmate from boarding school?
What kind of man will he become?

Studio Pieplus delivers you this sweet and fresh romance—either with a confident and elegant gentleman, or an affectionate and adorable alumnus. 

Look forward to further announcements from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202580/Beyond_Eden_Dear_Edward/]Steam Store[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/pieplus_eng]Twitter account[/url]!
